dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent bilateral narrowing from the mid-back region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with no discernible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a dark slate-grey skin tone across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Faint, low-frequency longitudinal grey streaks and subtle mottled patches distributed across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the primary dark grey baseline and lighter textured areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A sharp, high-contrast longitudinal mark is visible along the dorsal ridge; small, bright white circular points are present at the anterior extremity.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A pronounced axial furrow creating a linear shadow along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, straight longitudinal scar is situated along the primary dorsal ridge line.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined central dorsal ridge exhibiting significant topographical contrast from the lateral body mass.
